title: Mobile Pet Grooming Leads with Local Service Ads

facts.fact: The page was published March 13, 2026 and last updated September 16, 2026.
Google renamed its "Google Guaranteed" badge to "Google Verified" in October 2025, according to the page.
facts.quote: “Google Verified” (formerly “Google Guaranteed” — renamed by Google in October 2025) badge

facts.fact: According to the page, a searcher typically sees 2 LSA businesses first in Google results.
facts.quote: You’ll typically see 2 LSA businesses first.

facts.fact: The page states that with Local Services Ads advertisers pay only when a customer contacts them, not for clicks.
facts.quote: With LSAs, you pay only when someone contacts you.

facts.fact: In the page's example, a Local Service Ads campaign for a pet groomer in Ocoee, Florida generated 74 leads in February 2026, the highest month shown.
facts.quote: In February alone, the campaign generated 74 leads

facts.fact: In the page's Ocoee, Florida pet groomer LSA example, the campaign generated 14 leads in September 2025.
In the page's Ocoee, Florida pet groomer LSA example, the campaign generated 29 leads in October 2025.
In the page's Ocoee, Florida pet groomer LSA example, the campaign generated 24 leads in November 2025.
In the page's Ocoee, Florida pet groomer LSA example, the campaign generated 32 leads in December 2025.
In the page's Ocoee, Florida pet groomer LSA example, the campaign generated 39 leads in January 2026.
The page states that 10 to 20 new customers per month can fill mobile pet grooming schedules quickly (a vendor estimate, not a measured result).
facts.quote: even 10–20 new customers per month can fill grooming schedules quickly

facts.fact: The page says many mobile pet grooming clients become recurring appointments every 4 to 8 weeks.
facts.quote: many clients become recurring appointments every 4–8 weeks

facts.fact: The page claims that the Google Verified badge indicates background checks have been completed for the business.
